1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1000 Da__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to provide controlled release properties__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of less than 1000 Da__.

4. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex [[comprised]] __comprises__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter __and said polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1000 Da__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __and said polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than 1000 Da__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __having a molecular weight of less than 1000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __wherein said multivalent cation is present in an amount sufficient to provide controlled release properties__.

13. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer [[thai]] __that__ can be crosslinked with a) __wherein said polymer is selected from partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide and acrylate-based polymers__; and c) a fluid.

22. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis of 10-40%__.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or [[NN, dimethy ac.ylamide]] __N,N-dimethylacrylamide__.

26. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
